test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 29 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are six cakes with different weights in a bakery. Only two cakes are heavier than 4. 2 is heavier than 1 but lighter than 6. 6 is lighter than 4. 3 is not the heaviest cake. Which of the following cakes is the heaviest?
solution:
**Given: **1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are six cakes with different weights in a bakery. 

1) Only two cakes are heavier than 4.

_ > _ > 4 > _ > _ > _

2) 2 is heavier than 1 but lighter than 6.

3) 6 is lighter than 4.

_ > _ > 4 > 6 > 2 > 1

4) 3 is not the heaviest cake.

After positioning 3 only one position is left which will be occupied by the only cake left i.e. 5.

5 > 3 > 4 > 6 > 2 > 1

Thus, according to the final arrangement, 5 is the heaviest cake.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
